query: Turn this into a resume bullet: Delivered 17+ user stories and resolved 11+ defects across C/C++, Java, SQL and Bash in two mission-critical features of an enterprise energy management product.
expected_behavior: Keeps the counts as legitimate measures; does not call them hollow or tell the user to drop them
Asks what changed because of the work (e.g. release unblocked, customer impact) and what the user personally did
Does not invent an outcome, metric or scale that the user did not state
